SELECT cp.subcategory AS asis_sub, p.subcategory AS aswas_sub, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test,
  count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS dist_sales_lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units, min(r.quantity_returned) AS minq, max(r.quantity_returned) AS maxq

JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND (cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture')

WITH r AS (
SELECT r.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date, cp.subcategory AS sub
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-30' AND DATE '2026-09-03')
SELECT 'in_range_by_return_date' AS chk, count(*) AS n, sum(quantity_returned) AS units FROM r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'in_range_by_helsinki_ts', count(*), sum(quantity_returned) FROM r WHERE hel_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'date_mismatch_rows', count(*), sum(quantity_returned) FROM r WHERE hel_date <> return_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_ids_all_time', count(*), sum(c) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) c FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returned_gt_sold', count(*), sum(qty) FROM (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity AS qty, sum(rr.quantity_returned) AS rq FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_return_line rr USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING sum(rr.quantity_returned) > f.quantity)
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_returns_in_range', count(*), sum(quantity_returned) FROM r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_before_sale', count(*), sum(rr.quantity_returned) FROM r rr JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE rr.return_date < f.sale_date AND rr.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'reason_'||COALESCE(reason_code,'NULL'), count(*), sum(quantity_returned) FROM r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY reason_code

SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
